correctness.rationale: The independent gap composition formula gives A(z)=z(1-(1-p)z)/(1-pz+(1-p)z²). The exact trigonometric phase counts all simple roots and gives the root-density Jacobian. Positive real-root coefficients exclude further zeros at or beyond the discriminant boundary. The sign homomorphism gives all-time parity. Forty exhaustive rational checks independently confirm finite deck instances.

value.rationale: Permutation parity is the canonical nontrivial one-dimensional representation and a mathematically motivated observable for exact quotient mixing. Classifying all floor(n/2) one-step uniformization parameters and their nontrivial square-root-edge limiting density gives a natural complete structural invariant, not an arbitrary numerical slice or a recomputation of a mixing-time bound.
